title: Open Mic
tagline: A walk-on with no record and one skateboard.
hint: Hits raise damage, and damage makes launches longer. Smash attacks (I + a direction) finish.

intro.text: The Foundry. Every night at midnight the furnace floor becomes a stage, and the whole city tunes in.

take.text: The Foundry. Every night at midnight the furnace floor becomes a stage, and the whole city tunes in.

intro.text: Welcome back to Dose of Destruction. Tonight, a walk-on. No sponsor, no record, one skateboard.

take.text: Welcome back to Dose of Destruction. Tonight, a walk-on. No sponsor, no record, one skateboard.

intro.text: I'm not here for the show. I'm here for the exit.

take.text: I'm not here for the show. I'm here for the exit.

intro.text: They all say that. The only way out is through everyone else on the card. Kaelen, say hello.

take.text: They all say that. The only way out is through everyone else on the card. Kaelen, say hello.

intro.text: Hi. Bye.

take.text: Hi. Bye.

outro.text: You're slow off the ground. That won't last here.

take.text: You're slow off the ground. That won't last here.

outro.text: Neither will you.

take.text: Neither will you.

outro.text: The crowd likes the kid. Keep him on the card.

take.text: The crowd likes the kid. Keep him on the card.

title: House Heavy
tagline: The house fighter is the size of the house.
hint: Break is giant and heavy. Build damage before you go for the launch.

intro.text: The Rooftop. One long roof, nowhere to hide, and a long way down.

take.text: The Rooftop. One long roof, nowhere to hide, and a long way down.

intro.text: The house has rules. Rule one: I don't fall off.

take.text: The house has rules. Rule one: I don't fall off.

intro.text: You're the size of a building.

take.text: You're the size of a building.

intro.text: Correct.

take.text: Correct.

outro.text: ...I fell off.

take.text: ...I fell off.

outro.text: Ratings went up eleven points. Do it again.

take.text: Ratings went up eleven points. Do it again.

title: Bad Signal
tagline: Two on one, on platforms that will not hold still.
hint: Two of them, one stock each. Keep both in front of you and ride the moving platforms.

intro.text: The kid's a hit. Hits get remixed.

take.text: The kid's a hit. Hits get remixed.

intro.text: He says you talk too much.

take.text: He says you talk too much.

intro.text: I haven't said anything.

take.text: I haven't said anything.

intro.text: Exactly. Keep it that way.

take.text: Exactly. Keep it that way.

outro.text: Fine.

take.text: Fine.

outro.text: He talks?

take.text: He talks?

outro.text: Only when he loses.

take.text: Only when he loses.

title: Low Pressure
hint: Low gravity. Jumps hang and launches carry. Mind the gap in the middle.

intro.text: The Orchestrator asked for drama, so I brought the weather.

take.text: The Orchestrator asked for drama, so I brought the weather.

intro.text: The air goes thin. Everything floats a little longer than it should.

take.text: The air goes thin. Everything floats a little longer than it should.

intro.text: Is that allowed?

take.text: Is that allowed?

intro.text: It's a broadcast. Everything is allowed.

take.text: It's a broadcast. Everything is allowed.

outro.text: Huh. You fall like you mean it.

take.text: Huh. You fall like you mean it.

outro.text: Turn the gravity back on on your way out.

take.text: Turn the gravity back on on your way out.

title: Turn the Page
tagline: A partner, finally. He writes too.
hint: Blog Man fights with you. Teammates cannot hit each other, so gang up.

intro.text: I've been covering your run. Front page, three nights straight.

take.text: I've been covering your run. Front page, three nights straight.

intro.text: Great. Can you fight?

take.text: Great. Can you fight?

intro.text: Better than I write. Which is very well.

take.text: Better than I write. Which is very well.

intro.text: Aw. Two little friends.

take.text: Aw. Two little friends.

intro.text: I've got your back. Not theirs. Sorry.

take.text: I've got your back. Not theirs. Sorry.

outro.text: Headline: 'Walk-On and Writer Clean House.' Too long?

take.text: Headline: 'Walk-On and Writer Clean House.' Too long?

outro.text: Way too long.

take.text: Way too long.

title: Sudden Death
tagline: The show is running long. One stock, high damage.
hint: Both of you start at 150% with one stock. The first strong hit wins. Shield, then punish.

intro.text: We're running long, so this one is sudden death. Everybody starts at one-fifty.

take.text: We're running long, so this one is sudden death. Everybody starts at one-fifty.

intro.text: One clean hit. That's all this needs.

take.text: One clean hit. That's all this needs.

intro.text: Then don't miss.

take.text: Then don't miss.

outro.text: You flinched first. And you still won.

take.text: You flinched first. And you still won.

outro.text: I didn't flinch. I ducked.

take.text: I didn't flinch. I ducked.

title: Dead Weight
tagline: They want the kid off the air.
hint: Survive for 60 seconds. You do not need KOs. Stay away from the edges.

intro.text: The kid is getting too popular. Let's fix that. Boulder, Stratabots: take him off the air.

take.text: The kid is getting too popular. Let's fix that. Boulder, Stratabots: take him off the air.

intro.text: Plates locked.

intro.text: I don't have to beat them. I just have to still be here when the clock runs out.

take.text: I don't have to beat them. I just have to still be here when the clock runs out.

outro.text: He's still standing.

take.text: He's still standing.

outro.text: Plates... cracked.

take.text: Plates... cracked.

outro.text: Fine. I'll do it myself.

take.text: Fine. I'll do it myself.

title: Encore
tagline: The man who runs the show steps onto it.
hint: The final fight: a giant Orchestrator. Stay moving and punish his landings.

intro.text: Do you know what the exit is, kid? There isn't one. There's only the next show.

take.text: Do you know what the exit is, kid? There isn't one. There's only the next show.

intro.text: Then I'll end the show.

take.text: Then I'll end the show.

intro.text: Bold. Lights. Music. Everyone, watch this.

take.text: Bold. Lights. Music. Everyone, watch this.

outro.text: The baton hits the furnace floor. For the first time in years, the broadcast goes quiet.

take.text: The baton hits the furnace floor. For the first time in years, the broadcast goes quiet.

outro.text: ...Ratings?

outro.text: Highest ever. You're off the air, maestro.
